name: LiveVQA
description: LiveVQA is a large-scale dataset and benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal large language models on seeking and updating with live visual knowledge. It contains 107,143 samples across 12 categories, focusing on up-to-date visual information beyond model knowledge cutoffs.
reputation: A recent multimodal benchmark that is useful for evaluating live visual knowledge and up-to-date perception, but is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on evaluating model performance on live, evolving visual knowledge; includes extensive data from recent news and media; supports research on updating MLLMs.
